title: Regulations for manufacturing uses in Subareas B2 and B3
previewText: In Subareas B2 and B3, as shown on Map 1 (Special Inwood District – Subdistricts and Subareas) in the Appendix to this Chapter, the manufacturing uses permitted in M1 Districts shall be subject to the modifications set forth in Section 123-20 (SPECIAL USE REGULATIONS), inclusive.
